headline: Sparkit Static Electricity
title: Sparkit | Attack Boost For Electric Pals | Palworld Guide
video_script: Running Electric Pals? Add Sparkit. Its partner skill, Static Electricity, raises the Attack of Electric Pals in your party. At base it works Generating Electricity at level one, and it also helps with Handiwork and Transporting. It sometimes drops an Electric Organ at the Ranch too. It is an early Electric Pal that is easy to catch. Which Electric Pal do you run? Comment below!
description: Sparkit in Palworld 1.0: Static Electricity boosts Electric Pal attack, plus Generating Electricity level one.
